operation: Local exact-root reconciliation: candidate ID cmmmech:<candidate_key> AND material_kind must both match. No authority inventory refresh. The priority narrative is a research handoff, not acceptance of remaining candidates.

search_scope.enumeration_command: rg --files --no-ignore --hidden --follow data/records research reviews history; find data/records research reviews history -type l -print
search_scope.limits: Bounded task-worktree enumeration; underlying dossier research also records cited raw paths. No unrelated home/temp or global literature absence claim; binary PDFs are not assumed text-searchable.

limits: Root identity representation does not imply every authority designation or mechanism has been curated.
Commodity grades and groups overlap; adjudicate before creating roots.
Minerals and secondary resources outside the historical inventory remain eligible.
Shared primary experiments across elemental/host/resource records are not independent replications.

Historical inventory designations retain their original authority versions. Round10 natural-graphite work separately inspected UK replacement OR/24/059; this reconciliation does not silently update all UK mappings.

Natural graphite is represented only as its exact commodity root; broad graphite and battery-grade graphite remain overlapping, unrepresented proposals. Boron/fluorine elements do not automatically represent borates/fluorspar.
Round11 completes exact-root coverage of element proposals in this dated 94-root inventory only; identity-only records do not establish microbial mechanisms.
